title: Transmission for vehicles that can be switched under load
abstract: Manual transmission, with an input shaft (11) and output shaft (12) mounted in a transmission housing (7), with the following features: (a) In the gear housing (7) there is a primary crown gear (25) which is in constant meshing with a first crown gear pinion (23) and a secondary crown gear (26) which is in constant meshing with a second crown gear pinion (24). (b) The primary crown gear (25), the secondary crown gear (26), the first crown gear pinion (23) and the second crown gear pinion (24) are indirectly connected to the output shaft (12) and input shaft (11). (c) During one revolution of the primary crown wheel (25) or the secondary crown wheel (26), the first crown wheel pinion (23) or the second crown wheel pinion (24) is not in engagement with every tooth of the primary crown wheel (25) or the secondary crown wheel (26).
